patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; 6sense leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs 6sense (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs 6sense-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
